label: Pure-set representatives versus…: A small candidate domain B ⊕ S separates bearer candidates from…
definition: A small candidate domain B ⊕ S separates bearer candidates from set representatives. A supplied decode:S→Mathlib.ZFSet.{0} interprets representatives by actual mathematical pure sets. This is not a small universe of all ZF sets. No injectivity, all-set coverage or full membership closure is assumed. Object-level existence is Ontic.ExistsAt on the sum domain, not Lean inhabitation or mathematical set truth. sampleDecode interprets Bool false as ∅ and true as {∅}, not the earlier designated {2} candidate.
note: Analyst location/representation profile for #1109, attribution deferred. No claim that every set or every nominalist/realist theory has this profile. See docs/showcase-naturalism.md §4 and ATTEMPT-NATURALISM-SET-REPRESENTATIVES-1109.
